messages:
nora: Quick copy review for the snapshot delete confirmation modal. Current title: "Are you sure?" Body: "Delete snapshot?" Buttons: Cancel / OK. Feels ambiguous and non-descriptive. Figma: https://figma.redwood/snapshots/delete-modal
phil: Totally agree. Need to surface consequence. Proposal: Title: "Delete snapshot" Body: "Deleting this snapshot is permanent and cannot be undone. Any rollout using this snapshot will revert to the previous version." Primary CTA: "Delete snapshot" (red). Secondary: "Cancel".
tess: Accessibility & tone notes: add a short helper line for recovery options if any (e.g., contact support). Also include aria-describedby on the primary button pointing to the consequence text so SRs hear it. Keep sentences short for translations.
phil: Good call. Short helper: "Contact support to explore recovery options." only if recovery is possible; otherwise omit. Also suggest we avoid word "revert"  users may not know history semantics; use "fall back to previous version".
qa-bot: Checklist for PR: 1) Title and body updated per approved wording, 2) primary button labeled "Delete snapshot" and has aria-describedby, 3) primary button uses destructive color token with contrast check, 4) unit test verifies focus lands on Cancel by default to avoid accidental deletes, 5) localization note added.
nora: Final approved copy: Title: "Delete snapshot" Body: "This will permanently delete the snapshot and cannot be undone. The system will fall back to the previous version if needed." CTA primary: "Delete snapshot" CTA secondary: "Cancel" Helper (optional): "Contact support to discuss recovery." OK to ship?
phil: Approved. I'll update the component and include aria-describedby and reduced-motion for the exit animation.
tess: I'll run a quick a11y smoke test after the PR. QA-bot please create the ticket.
qa-bot: Ticket #4478 created with copy, acceptance criteria, and Figma frame id: figma://frame/snapshots/delete/12. (auto-note)
nora: Thanks all. Small follow-up: ensure keyboard focus defaults to Cancel to reduce risk. :white_check_mark:
